svg.title: Projects and open source
svg.desc: Life Ledger: Tasks, goals, meals and money in one app, with an assistant that turns what you say into entries. portfolio-2.0: My portfolio and resume site, live at likheet.is-a.dev (Next.js, Framer Motion). YTFast: YouTube Music, native and fast. A desktop app for Windows and Mac, for YouTube Music Premium accounts. Nucleus-AI: Grounded chatbot for the UNSW Nucleus Student Hub. It answers only from official UNSW pages and cites its sources. draftcue: Rewrite selected text in place with Gemini using a keyboard shortcut. Youtube-ify: A YouTube-inspired control layer with reliable shortcuts, cinema mode, and true fullscreen for HTML5 video across the web. Merged pull requests: vorssaint/vorssaint-utils (31k stars), 11 merged, newest: fix(capture): keep the recent captures palette open for Clear history. foliojs/pdfkit (10k stars), 1 merged, newest: Note that center and right alignment apply to each continued segment. pydantic/monty (8.8k stars), 7 merged, newest: Write a function's repr without quotes around its name. SchemaStore/schemastore (3.9k stars), 1 merged, newest: pre-commit-hooks: add haskell and julia languages, fix fail_fast description. foliojs/fontkit (1.7k stars), 5 merged, newest: Fix repha, pre-base vowel and dotted circle placement in USE. fancy-regex/fancy-regex (641 stars), 2 merged, newest: Balance the explicit stack when a condition fails. devopness/devopness (573 stars), 1 merged, newest: ci: Enable stale workflow for PRs to close abandoned pull requests.
